storage: Keep whole bulbs in a cool, dry, ventilated basket away from potatoes; keep peeled shallots in a closed box in the fridge for 3 to 4 days.
looksLike: Small, round to oval onions about 2 to 4 cm across with a reddish-purple, papery skin and a pink-purple flesh; they grow in clusters. Sold as "sambar onion", "small onion" or "Madras onion".
howToPick: Hard, plump bulbs with dry, shiny skin and no sprouting. Avoid soft spots, mould or a damp smell.
shelfLife: Several weeks in a cool, dry, airy place; peeled ones only a few days in the fridge (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Spring onion bulbs or white onion
